hindi: विजिगीषु इस प्रकार दूसरी प्रकृति को सहारा दे।
english: The conqueror should support the second constituent element in this way.
notes: The text does not say which prakṛti is 'the second'; not guessed. 'evam' refers to what follows in the chapter. upagṛhṇīyāt rendered 'support' (cf. glossary 11.1 upagṛhya).

words.gloss: in forts, forests and places of retreat
having got a share of the gain

hindi: सामन्त पर सामन्त के साथ मिलकर चढ़ाई करे, या यदि सोचे “मेरी पार्ष्णि नहीं पकड़ेगा, पार्ष्णिग्राह को रोकेगा, चढ़ाई करने योग्य के पास नहीं जाएगा, मेरे लिए सेना की द्विगुणता होगी, मेरे लिए रसद और सहायक सेना को प्रवृत्त करेगा, दूसरे का निवारण करेगा, बहुत बाधाओं वाले मेरे मार्ग में काँटों को कुचलेगा, दुर्ग, वन और अपसारों में सेना के साथ विचरण करेगा, चढ़ाई करने योग्य को असह्य दोष में या सन्धि में रखेगा, या लाभ का अंश पाया हुआ दूसरे शत्रुओं को मेरे प्रति विश्वास कराएगा”।
english: [He] should march against a neighbouring chief, joining with a neighbouring chief, or if [he] should think: “[He] will not seize my heel; [he] will restrain the heel-seizer; [he] will not go up to the one to be marched against; there will be a doubling of the army for me; [he] will set in motion for me the supplies and reinforcements; [he] will restrain [those] of the other; [he] will crush the thorns on my path with its many hindrances; [he] will move about with the army in forts, forests and places of retreat; [he] will place the one to be marched against in an unbearable defect or in a treaty; or, having got a share of the gain, [he] will make other enemies trust me.”
notes: Subject of 'yāyāt' and of the quoted verbs is not stated ('[he]' in English only). First 'sāmantam' is read as object of yāyāt (march against) and 'sāmantena' as the partner; the sense 'taking a neighbouring chief along with a neighbouring chief' is also possible. pārṣṇi: 'heel' as in glossary 12.3 (pārṣṇiṃ grah). 'yātavyaṃ na-abhisariṣyati': abhi-√sṛ rendered literally 'go up to'; 'advance against' is possible. 'parasya vārayiṣyati': object missing (probably the supplies/reinforcements of the other); left elliptical. vīvadha = supplies, āsāra = reinforcements here (as 10.4). doṣa rendered 'defect' (glossary 3.15); 'fault' or 'difficulty' possible. daṇḍa = army; apasāra = place of retreat (10.2). The quotation closes with iti.

hindi: या दो प्रकार का होकर, कोश के द्वारा सेना को, सेना के द्वारा कोश को, सामन्तों में से किसी एक से पाने की इच्छा करे।
english: Or, having become twofold, [he] should seek to obtain army by means of treasury, treasury by means of army, from any one of the neighbouring chiefs.
notes: dvaidhī-bhūta is rendered literally 'having become twofold'; a link to dvaidhī-bhāva (the dual policy) is possible but not stated. Subject not stated. 'anyatamāl' is regular sandhi for anyatamāt.

hindi: उनमें श्रेष्ठ से अधिक अंश के द्वारा, समान से समान के द्वारा, हीन से हीन के द्वारा — यह सम-सन्धि है।
english: Among them: from the superior with a greater share, from the equal with an equal [share], from the inferior with an inferior [share] — such is the equal treaty.

text_flags.why: possible typo: doubled d (hīnādd hīnena); the same doubling before an initial h recurs in units 11, 18, 29, so it may be an e-text habit, but the word is hīnāt

notes: Elliptical: 'share' is carried to samena and hīnena (bracketed in English only). jyāyasaḥ read as ablative parallel to samāt/hīnāt; a genitive reading is possible. The closing iti belongs to the section label (glossary: 'Such is X'; iti glossed 'closing particle'). sama-sandhi = equal treaty (literal).

hindi: विपर्यय में विषम-सन्धि।
english: In reversal, [there is] the unequal treaty.
notes: Verbless; copula bracketed in English only.

hindi: उन दोनों में विशेष लाभ से अतिसन्धि।
english: Of the two, from a special gain, [there is] atisandhi (the treaty of outwitting).
notes: 'tayoḥ' = of the two kinds just named (sama and viṣama). atisandhi kept as a term; literal 'treaty of outwitting' (cf. atisandhā = outwit). Copula bracketed in English only.

hindi: हीन, व्यसन वाले, विनाश के स्थान में लगे हुए या अर्थ न चाहने वाले श्रेष्ठ से सेना के बराबर लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: The inferior should strike a bargain with a superior [one] who is afflicted, engaged in a place of ruin, or not seeking gain, with a gain equal to the army.
notes: vyasanin: 'afflicted' (glossary 3.11); 'given to vice' is possible. apāya-sthāna 'place of ruin' is literal and uncertain (sthāna may mean position/occasion). anarthin: 'not seeking gain' (an-arthin); alternatives 'without purpose' or 'suffering loss'. bala = army (glossary 8.5); 'strength' possible. paṇ = strike a bargain.

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.

words.gloss: for filling up the deficient power and majesty
one advancing on a probable gain
for protecting the base and rear

hindi: या ऐसा होकर, हीन शक्ति और प्रताप की पूर्ति के लिए, सम्भावित अर्थ की ओर बढ़ने वाला, या मूल और पिछले भाग की रक्षा के लिए, हीन श्रेष्ठ से सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or, being of such kind — for filling up [his] deficient power and majesty, one advancing on a probable gain, or for protecting [his] base and rear — the inferior should strike a bargain with a superior with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: hīna-śakti-pratāpa-pūraṇa could also be read 'filling up the power and majesty of the inferior'. pratāpa rendered 'majesty' (literally 'heat, glory'); 'might' possible. sambhāvya-artha = 'probable/expected gain'; abhisārin = 'advancing on' (literal; 'attacker' possible). pārṣṇi in mūla-pārṣṇi = rear (glossary 12.1). 'bala-samād viśiṣṭena lābhena' = a gain better than the one equal to the army (understood). 'evaṃ-bhūta' refers back to the situation of the preceding units.

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: The one bargained with should favour one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: kalyāṇa-buddhi = of good intent (glossary 9.3); the person is not named. anugṛhṇīyāt = 'should favour' (literally 'take hold with favour').

words.gloss: in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point
for whom loss has set in

hindi: व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले, या उपस्थित अनर्थ वाले श्रेष्ठ से हीन, या दुर्ग और मित्र से सहारा पाया हुआ, छोटा मार्ग तय करके शत्रु पर जाने की इच्छा वाला, या बिना युद्ध के अथवा एक-अन्त सिद्धि वाले लाभ को लेने की इच्छा वाला, सेना के बराबर से हीन लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: The inferior, with a superior in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point, or for whom loss has set in — or [the inferior] being supported by fort and ally, desiring to march a short road against the enemy, or desiring to take a gain without battle or of one-sided success — should strike a bargain with a gain lower than [one] equal to the army.

text_flags.why: possible typo: doubled d before hīnena (same in units 4, 18, 29)

notes: The first compound is read 'jāta-vyasana' + 'prakṛti-randhra' (calamity has arisen; weak point in the constituent elements); a different division is possible. The sentence has two alternatives (vā): the superior is in calamity/loss, or the inferior is supported by fort and ally; the exact syntax is not certain. 'śatrum' taken with yātu-kāmaḥ (march against). eka-anta-siddhi = 'success at one end', rendered 'one-sided' (ekānta may mean 'certain'). pratiṣṭabdha: 'supported' (prati-stabdha; 'obstructed' is possible). anartha = loss (glossary 9.7).

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.

words.gloss: free of weak point and calamity
one whose action is badly begun

hindi: या श्रेष्ठ, रन्ध्र और व्यसन से रहित, बुरी तरह आरम्भ किए कर्म वाले को और अधिक क्षय और व्यय से जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, दूष्य सेना को दूर भेजने की इच्छा वाला, या दूष्य सेना को बुलाने की इच्छा वाला, पीड़न के योग्य अथवा उच्छेदन के योग्य को हीन के द्वारा व्यथित करने की इच्छा वाला, या सन्धि को प्रधान रखने वाला, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाला, हीन लाभ को स्वीकार कर ले।
english: Or a superior free of weak point and calamity, desiring to connect one whose action is badly begun with further loss and expenditure, desiring to send away the treasonable army, or desiring to bring in the treasonable army, desiring to distress, by means of the inferior, [one] to be afflicted or to be uprooted, or with treaty foremost, [being] of good intent, should accept a lesser gain.
notes: a-randhra-vyasana read 'free of both weak point and calamity'; 'whose weak point is not a calamity' is possible. yoktu-kāma: yuj with instrumental, rendered literally 'connect' (sense 'burden'). pravāsayitu 'send away' (caus. of pra-√vas, glossary 4.13 for non-persons); āvāhayitu 'bring in'. dūṣya-daṇḍa read 'treasonable army'; 'army of the treasonable' possible. The subject of pratigṛhṇīyāt is the superior (jyāyān). daṇḍa = army (glossary 8.5). The long list of descriptions is a single subject group; the exact grouping of the vā-alternatives is uncertain.

hindi: कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले के साथ मिलकर अर्थ पाने की इच्छा करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: [He] should seek to obtain gain, joining with one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: Subject not stated. 'sambhūya-artham': the e-text joins the two words with '-'; read as two words (having joined; gain). artha = gain.

hindi: इस प्रकार समान समान को छल ले या अनुग्रह करे।
english: In this way an equal should outwit an equal, or favour [him].
notes: Object of anugṛhṇīyāt not repeated; '[him]' bracketed in English only.

words.gloss: for protecting the base and rear

hindi: सम, सेना के बराबर लाभ के द्वारा, दूसरे के सेना-दल के प्रति-सेना-दल को, या मित्रों और वन-जातियों के, शत्रु की विभूमियों के मार्गदर्शक को, या मूल और पिछले भाग की रक्षा के लिए सौदा करे।
english: An equal should strike a bargain, with a gain equal to the army, [for] a counter-division to the other's division or [to that] of allies and forest tribes, [for] a guide to the enemy's bad grounds, or for the protection of the base and rear.
notes: Accusatives (pratyanīkam, deśikam) are taken as what is bargained for; '[for]' is bracketed in English. 'mitra-aṭavīnām' parallel to 'para-anīkasya' (genitive); aṭavī here = forest tribes (force sense). vibhūmi 'bad ground' is literal (cf. abhūmi 10.2); sense uncertain. pārṣṇi = rear (12.1).

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: The one bargained with should favour one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: kalyāṇa-buddhi = of good intent (glossary 9.3); the person is not named. anugṛhṇīyāt = 'should favour' (literally 'take hold with favour').

words.gloss: [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √labh; m. nom. sg.

hindi: व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले, अनेक से विरुद्ध से, या दूसरी ओर से पाता हुआ सम, सेना के बराबर से हीन लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: [With one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point, [and who is] opposed by many, or [when] obtaining [it] from elsewhere, an equal should strike a bargain with a gain lower than [one] equal to the army.

text_flags.why: possible typo: doubled d before hīnena (same in units 4, 11, 29)

notes: The object of paṇeta (the party bargained with) is not named; '[With one]' is bracketed. labhamāna has no object stated ('[it]' bracketed). aneka-viruddha = 'opposed by many' (literal).

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.

words.gloss: whose business depends on a neighbouring chief
whose army is to be made

hindi: या ऐसा हुआ सम, जिसका कार्य सामन्त के अधीन है, या जिसकी सेना बनानी है, सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or, being of such kind, an equal whose business depends on a neighbouring chief, or whose army is to be made, should strike a bargain with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: kartavya-bala 'whose army is to be made' is literal; the sense (an army not yet raised) is not stated. The party bargained with is not named.

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, कल्याण-बुद्धि वाले पर अनुग्रह करे; अन्यथा आक्रमण करे।
english: The one bargained with should favour one of good intent; otherwise [he] should attack.
notes: kalyāṇa-buddhi = of good intent (glossary 9.3); the person is not named. anugṛhṇīyāt = 'should favour' (literally 'take hold with favour').

words.gloss: [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point
than the one to be marched against

words.gram: pres. part. mid. √labh; m. nom. sg.

hindi: व्यसन उत्पन्न हुए, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाले पर प्रहार करने की इच्छा वाला; या सुआरम्भ किए हुए अथवा एक-अन्त सिद्धि वाले, इसके कर्म को नष्ट करने की इच्छा वाला; मूल पर या यात्रा में प्रहार करने की इच्छा वाला; या चढ़ाई करने योग्य से अधिक पाता हुआ, श्रेष्ठ, हीन या सम से और माँगे।
english: Desiring to strike down [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point; desiring to destroy his action, well begun or of one-sided success; desiring to strike at the base or on the march; or obtaining more than from the one to be marched against — [he] should ask more of a superior, an inferior or an equal.

text_flags.why: possible typo: stray compound dot; ablative of comparison 'more than from the yātavya' is two words

notes: Subject not stated. 'eka-anta-siddhim' may qualify karma or stand as a noun ('one-sided success'). 'bhūyaḥ' = more (or 'again'). 'yātrā' = march (9.1). The last clause has the verb yāceta; whether the earlier desires are conditions or alternatives is not certain.

words.gloss: for the protection of his own army

hindi: या अधिक माँगा गया, अपनी सेना की रक्षा के लिए दूसरे की सेना के द्वारा दुर्धर्ष दूसरे का दुर्ग, आसार या वन कुचलने की इच्छा वाला, या लम्बे मार्ग अथवा काल में दूसरे की सेना को क्षय और व्यय से जोड़ने की इच्छा वाला, या दूसरे की सेना के द्वारा बढ़ा हुआ उसी को उखाड़ने की इच्छा वाला, या दूसरे की सेना को लेने की इच्छा वाला, अधिक दे।
english: Or, being asked for more, [he] should give more — desiring, for the protection of his own army, to crush with the other's army an unassailable fort of another, a reinforcer or a forest; or desiring to connect the other's army with loss and expenditure on a long road or in a long time; or, grown through the other's army, desiring to uproot that very one; or desiring to take the other's army.
notes: 'bhūyaḥ' = more (or 'again'). 'durdharṣam' may qualify only anya-durgam or all three objects. āsāra here 'reinforcer' (6.2), 'reinforcements' (10.4) possible. 'prakṛṣṭe' agrees with both adhvani and kāle ('long road or long time'). 'para-daṇḍa' = the other's army (para = the other). 'tam' = the one whose army has made him grow (not named). Subject not stated.

words.gloss: on the pretext of the one to be marched against

hindi: या श्रेष्ठ, हीन को चढ़ाई करने योग्य के बहाने हाथ में करने की इच्छा वाला; या दूसरे को उखाड़कर उसी को उखाड़ने की इच्छा वाला; या त्याग करके वापस लेने की इच्छा वाला, सेना के बराबर से विशिष्ट लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or a superior, desiring to bring the inferior into [his] hand on the pretext of the one to be marched against; or, having uprooted the other, desiring to uproot that very one; or, having made a relinquishment, desiring to take [it] back — should strike a bargain with a gain better than [one] equal to the army.
notes: haste kartu = literally 'to put in the hand' (bring under control). apadeśa = pretext (literally 'pointing out'). 'param' = the other (not 'enemy'); 'tam' = that very one (not named). tyāga = relinquishment (giving up); the object of pratyādātu is not stated ('[it]' bracketed). The party bargained with is not named.

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.

text_flags.why: stray hyphen inside the word (paṇita-s for paṇitas)

notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.

words.gloss: united with the one to be marched against
army of the treasonable, enemies and forest tribes

hindi: या चढ़ाई करने योग्य से मिला हुआ रहे; या इसे दूष्य, शत्रु और वन-जातियों की सेना दे।
english: Or [he] should stay united with the one to be marched against; or [he] should give him the army of the treasonable, enemies and forest tribes.
notes: Subject not stated. daṇḍa = army. aṭavī here = forest tribes (force sense). The compound could also be read 'treasonable, enemy and forest troops'. 'Stay' (tiṣṭhet) is literal.

words.gloss: [one] in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point

hindi: या व्यसन उत्पन्न हुआ, प्रकृतियों में रन्ध्र वाला श्रेष्ठ हीन से सेना के बराबर लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: Or a superior in whom calamity has arisen, [whose] constituent elements have a weak point, should strike a bargain with an inferior with a gain equal to the army.
notes: Compound divided as in unit 11 (calamity has arisen; weak point in the constituent elements); the division is uncertain.

hindi: सौदा किया हुआ, उसकी हानि करने में समर्थ, आक्रमण करे; अन्यथा सन्धि करे।
english: The one bargained with, [if] capable of harming him, should attack; otherwise [he] should conclude a treaty.
notes: paṇita = the one with whom the bargain is struck (pp. of √paṇ); the text does not say who he is, nor whom 'tasya' (him) refers to. vikram- rendered 'attack' (literally 'stride forth, show prowess'). sandhā rendered 'conclude a treaty' (sandhi = treaty). Subject of the second clause not stated; '[he]' supplied in English only.

hindi: इस प्रकार हुए हीन से श्रेष्ठ सेना के बराबर से हीन लाभ के द्वारा सौदा करे।
english: A superior should strike a bargain with an inferior of such kind with a gain lower than [one] equal to the army.

hindi: आरम्भ में सौदा किया हुआ और सौदा करने वाला कारण को जानें; तब दोनों ओर से विचार करके जिस ओर श्रेष्ठ है, उस ओर जाए।
english: At first the one bargained with and the one bargaining should discern the cause; then, having reflected on both sides, [he] should go to the side on which [there is] the better.

notes: budhyeta is singular with two subjects (agrees with the nearer). 'yataḥ ... tataḥ' read as 'on which side ... to that side'. 'ubhayataḥ' could also be 'from both sides'. Metre: two regular anuṣṭubh lines (8+8).
